<thought>Search the template catalog using the correct functional group names: “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds”. Also specify that a C‑O bond is broken and a C‑C bond is formed in the forward reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
